events.continuity_hook: Keep the chosen flight and hotel confirmations available for any occupancy, schedule, or transportation follow-up before departure.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the better overall hotel pairing, verify the final trip total and cancellation terms, and complete both reservations.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus and his husband have decided that the earlier arrival is worth the added airfare because it preserves most of their first vacation day. They now need to compare the complete three-person trip totals for the Coronado and La Jolla finalists, including airport transportation, parking, and the usable time on arrival day, before reserving the flights and one hotel.

events.continuity_hook: Preserve the corrected guest details with the family itinerary for the later pre-departure review.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the room's three-person occupancy directly against the reservation and obtain an updated confirmation with every traveler reflected.
events.scenario_brief: The hotel confirmation for the selected Coronado property lists two adults but does not clearly show Marcus's 12-year-old son, even though the reserved room was presented as suitable for three guests. Marcus needs to confirm that the child is included, that the existing bedding is valid for all three travelers, and that adding his age will not alter the rate.

events.continuity_hook: Carry the strongest same-day itinerary and the best evening-before alternative into a lodging and total-cost comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Compare same-day and prior-evening flight plans using realistic airport-to-office timing and identify the most workable option in each case.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus has been assigned a one-day operations review in Minneapolis on a Thursday in May. He needs to travel from Chicago, reach a downtown office by 9:30 a.m., and return after the review ends at 4:00 p.m.; the team has not yet decided whether an evening-before arrival is necessary.

events.continuity_hook: Retain two complete combinations so the trip can be finalized once the organizer confirms the Thursday ending time.
events.interaction_goal: Compare a compact set of evening flights and downtown hotels on total cost, arrival practicality, walking time, and cancellation terms.
events.scenario_brief: The review organizer has moved the first required meeting to 8:45 a.m., making the same-day flight too risky. Marcus now needs a Wednesday evening flight and one hotel night near the downtown office, while still returning to Chicago after 4:00 p.m. Thursday; the employer's reimbursable hotel amount is known, but the final flight-hotel combination has not been selected.

events.continuity_hook: Record the completed Minneapolis itinerary for quick reference if the meeting schedule or airline timing shifts.
events.interaction_goal: Validate the Thursday door-to-door timing, select the viable return flight, and complete the flight and hotel bookings.
events.scenario_brief: The organizer has confirmed that the Minneapolis review will finish by 3:45 p.m. Marcus has selected one Wednesday evening flight and a hotel a short walk from the office, but he needs the Thursday airport transfer checked before choosing between two return flights and completing the trip reservations.

events.continuity_hook: Leave the family itinerary ready for departure, with any airport pickup timing adjustment reflected in the final details.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck the updated outbound timing, hotel arrival details, transportation plan, and traveler information without reopening settled trip choices.
events.scenario_brief: Two weeks before the San Diego vacation, the airline has shifted the family's outbound departure 35 minutes later while leaving the arrival time close to the original schedule. Marcus wants to confirm that the revised itinerary still works with the Coronado hotel's check-in window and their planned airport transportation, and he also needs all three traveler names and the corrected hotel guest count checked against the confirmations.
